title: Matched local Stage-1 families through fixed ray sweep and CUDA 3D refinement
question: On two development frames, how do three fixed-count Stage-1 fitting families rank under one exact-query initializer and one fixed CUDA RGB refinement schedule?
hypothesis: A family with better training-view observation fidelity will rank better in downstream held-out foreground PSNR; absence of transferable ranking retains downstream evaluation as necessary.
claim_boundary: Workload-specific development only: two previously exposed frames from one capture. Compare specified fitting families, not compositor equations in isolation. No general surrogate, default, novel lifter, compression-ratio, compact-only VRAM or Original-3DGS claim. Timings are exploratory under any GPU contention; shared Stage-1 acquisition is charged once and not treated as three independent fitting-time measurements. Frame00009 is within-capture consistency, not an independent replication. A null result is bounded to this fixed 256-row SH0 horizon and is not evidence of family equivalence.

stages.label: Fixed-topology RGB refinement
stages.purpose: Optimize against training RGB/masks with the same final-checkpoint CUDA gsplat schedule.

comparators.label: Native additive
comparators.purpose: Fixed-count native additive CUDA L2 fitting control.

comparators.label: StructSplat normalized
comparators.purpose: Fixed-count normalized CUDA L2 fitting with no mask containment.

comparators.label: StructSplat contained
comparators.purpose: Same normalized configuration with geometric mask containment enabled.

primary_metrics.label: Held-out foreground PSNR
primary_metrics.aggregation: Mean of three per-view foreground PSNRs; paired seed means within frame; show both frame units separately.

primary_metrics.label: Held-out alpha IoU
primary_metrics.aggregation: Mean per held-out view then paired seeds within frame.

primary_metrics.label: Held-out exterior alpha leakage
primary_metrics.aggregation: Mean predicted alpha outside source mask, then mean over views and seeds within frame.

primary_metrics.label: Complete consumed field bytes
primary_metrics.aggregation: One manifest plus all consumed training-view archives per frame/family; include cameras/alpha and framing.

primary_metrics.label: Lift and refinement wall time
primary_metrics.aggregation: Three paired-seed observations; exploratory whenever GPU contention is observed.

primary_metrics.label: Peak CUDA allocated
primary_metrics.aggregation: Maximum per fresh downstream worker; show raw seeds and medians.

primary_metrics.label: Final Gaussian count
primary_metrics.aggregation: Exactly 256 in every successful downstream cell.

resource_protocol.scope: Stage1 acquisition measured once per frame/family and reused across seeds. Worker resource clocks include lazy imports/JIT/cache setup. Downstream helper clock runs from generated-field load through final model save, lift and refinement separately synchronized; reporting excluded and separately timed. Warmup workers are separately recorded/excluded from primary aggregation, which does not prove later compilation overhead absent. Contended timings never support speed claims.
resource_protocol.aggregation: Warmup seed19999 once per frame/family, identical downstream settings, excluded. Measured seeds19001/19002/19003 retained; A/A replicas excluded. Report median/min/max and GPU contention. Stage1 acquisition shared once, no independentfit-timing claim.

two_phase_protocol.phase1: After initial ready-task review and clean init-run, generate inputs below inputs/ only. Publish immutable generated-input and supported-metric manifests. Do not execute downstream.
two_phase_protocol.phase2: Wait for independently approved finalized StructSplat BENCH019 protocol at protocol/structsplat.frozen.json bound to all generated fields/metrics and immutable RTGS task bytes. Validate both envelopes and source bindings before dispatch.
two_phase_protocol.generated_input_policy: Raw-only source seal covers external calibration/JPEG/PNG and selection metadata. Generated compact fields are outputs, separately hashed in phase1 and sealed as phase2 inputs. Ready task stays unchanged.
two_phase_protocol.phase2_publication: Prepare and finalize under a noncanonical staging filename. Complete required Struct review/task metadata commit, record initial and new commits, and verify both worktrees clean with unchanged source inventories. Only then atomically publish protocol/structsplat.frozen.json to release the waiting coordinator.

production.crop: tight thresholded foreground bbox plus 5 percent margin; identical crop for every family
production.target: same soft-alpha-matted RGB crop on black; common unweighted pixel L2 mean
production.seed_rule: 190000 + 100*frame_index + view_index in frozen sorted frame/train-view order; identical across families
production.family_axis: native additive vs normalized, with normalized mask-containment control only
production.initialization: Frozen family-specific initialization and schedules: native gradient sampling/bounded colors/trainable weights/cosine LR; StructSplat anisotropic structure-tensor WSE initialization/constant colors/no opacity/constant Adam LR. Both normalized variants use support_fade; geometric containment is the contained-family difference. No isolated compositor claim.
production.source_export_parity: Record native renderer vs declared observation support discrepancy separately; require exact cold serialization replay, not false lossless native-CUDA boundary equivalence.

family_factors.common: 512 fixed rows,1000 uninterrupted updates, shared external crop/matte, unweighted raw RGB L2, final checkpoint, constant per-row color, no topology/early stop/AA/filter/QAT/color solve
family_factors.native_additive: Gradient-magnitude+uniform .7/.3 pixel sampling using seeded torch Generator; .6*sqrt(HW/N) isotropic initialization (min .4); sampled colors and .5 weights. Sigmoid xy/RGB/weights and Cholesky softplus+.3. Adam lr .01, cosine T_max1000/eta_min .001. Additive native q<12 hard ellipse; exported observation rounded-AABB sqrt12 support, fade0, epsilon1e-8 inert. Native-to-observation boundary drift reported separately.
family_factors.structsplat_contained: Exactly normalized init and optimizer. Same initial draw then fit-entry geometric projection/isotropic SDF cap, margin1.5, mask>=.5. Shared explicit constraint applied before step0 and passed as fit override. Support fade1 shared with noncontained control; no density masking, target dilation, pixel weighting, or mask loss.
family_factors.structsplat_normalized: aniso_onedge/WSE tensor-aligned sampling using seeded NumPy Generator; spacing scales with no feature cap, bilinear colors, opacity none (unit amplitudes). Raw unbounded trainable colors; Adam default parameter-group rates (.05 means,.03 scales,.01 rotation,.03 colors), constant schedule. Normalized support_fade1, sigma3, epsilon1e-8.

production.history_policy: 0,100,250,500,750,1000. Source renderer post-update L2; step0 includes fit-entry constraint. Native existing diagnostic snapshots (all event cloning overhead included); Struct read-only observer re-renders requested states, ignores callback pre-update loss. Timing descriptive including diagnostics.

downstream_config.unsupported_anchor_policy: retain bounded midpoint as current initializer; report supported/fallback counts, no per-family tuning
downstream_config.objective: Frozen Trainer defaults: random-background masked L1/D-SSIM plus alpha losses, with opacity_reg and scale_reg zero; distinct from common black-matted unweighted L2 used in Stage1.

predictor_policy.scoring: clamped display-referred exact observation queries against shared processed training target; support is not alpha

resolved_scoring.aggregation: pool sufficient statistics over training views, then evaluate formulas
resolved_scoring.boundary: 3x3 binary morphological gradient with exterior padding=background
resolved_scoring.cold_replay: same pixel samples, CPU float64, max_abs <= 1e-10; valid exact
resolved_scoring.display: exact observation RGB clamped to [0,1] only for scoring
resolved_scoring.sampling: 2048 uniform full-canvas draws with replacement; same samples across families
resolved_scoring.support: query.valid and query.weight_sum > 1e-8; support threshold, not alpha
resolved_scoring.target: float32 processed RGB times soft source alpha, on black

decision_policy.scope: One capture cannot establish a general surrogate; report per-frame paired comparisons and preserve general insufficiency.
decision_policy.materiality_rule: For each comparator, mean paired PSNR difference over3seeds >=0.25dB in BOTH frames, all3paired seed differences positive in each frame, and mean alphaIoU decrease<=0.02 in each frame. Otherwise no material difference detected at this capacity/horizon; never equivalence or refutation of general hypothesis.
decision_policy.uncertainty: Report every view/seed cell and paired seed range/std, both within-capture frame means; no independence-based confidence interval from one capture. Struct analysis capture minimum remains3 and insufficiency is not a negative scientific gate.

aa_replay.failed_replay: invalidate comparative conclusions; preserve all receipts; no tolerance tuning
aa_replay.order: Run native primary/replay and contained primary/replay first for frame00008 seed19001; stop comparisons on any A/A failure before remaining primary matrix.
aa_replay.timing_aggregation: Exclude A/A replay rows and all warmups; retain primary seed19001 rows in the3seed comparison.

environment_policy.timing: exploratory if foreign compute process exists; do not alter other processes

scoring.evaluation_canvas: full undistorted downscale8 source frame, never training crop
scoring.alpha_source: PNG normalized float alpha after fixed calibrated undistortion and resize; never field weight sum
scoring.matted_target: processed float RGB * processed soft alpha on black, no intermediate8bitquantization
scoring.foreground_psnr: -10log10(max(mean((clamped_prediction-matted_target)^2 over all3channels and foreground pixels),1e-12)); arithmetic mean of3per-view PSNRs
scoring.exterior_leakage: mean(clamp(predicted_alpha,0,1) over every full-frame pixel outside foreground); require nonempty exterior
scoring.stage1_foreground_truth: same soft-alpha-matted common target; fixed2048uniform pixel samples include only trainingviews
scoring.support_confusion: valid & (weight_sum > 1e-8) exact field-query supported point vs sourcealpha>=0.5 at same samples; report IoU and raw counts, never interpret support or weight sum as alpha
scoring.boundary_mae: mean absolute channel error on maskboundary samples; boundary=3x3 morphological gradient of sourcealpha>=0.5
scoring.empty_metric_policy: fail cell on absent foreground/exterior; boundary sampling uses deterministic completeboundary fallback if sample has none, recorded in predictor provenance
scoring.cold_replay_device: float64 CPU exact query of serialized vs pre-serialization observation on same seededpixelpoints
scoring.native_source_export_drift: descriptive only with source renderer and declared observation equations labeled; cold observation replay remains hard gate

initializer_diagnostic.disposition: initializer-sensitive descriptive flag; no rejection/rescue/tuning and no fitting-fidelity causal interpretation
initializer_diagnostic.bounds: same camera-only bounds from frozen trainingcalibration, bounds_hintNone; assert bounds equal across families

resource_monitor.cuda_peak_reset: before generated field load; Trainer reset disabled
resource_monitor.process_scope: fresh process before inputload through final model save; reporting excluded
resource_monitor.nvml_failure: explicitly record unavailable diagnostic and no process-memory claim; never substitute totaldeviceusage for ownprocessusage
resource_monitor.contention: record foreign computePIDs/memory atentry,periodically,andexit; any foreign process makes time descriptive

pipeline_stages.label: Stage-1 field fitting
pipeline_stages.purpose: Fit the common training-only cropped/matted target at equal fixed count and horizon; freeze exact observation artifacts.

pipeline_stages.label: Exact-query ray sweep
pipeline_stages.purpose: Use the same field-sweep settings and exact family observation equations at a fixed 3D row count.

pipeline_stages.label: Fixed-topology RGB refinement
pipeline_stages.purpose: Optimize against training RGB/masks with the same final-checkpoint CUDA gsplat schedule.

pipeline_stages.label: Held-out reporting
pipeline_stages.purpose: Evaluate saved models in a separate reporting process only after all choices are frozen.

fitting_history_policy: Shared v2 history contains measured per-cell refinement only. Stage1 acquisition per-view histories remain separate linked sources and curves, acquired once per frame/family and never relabeled as independent downstream-seed measurements. Lift/evaluation/preparation clocks are explicit source receipts and stage-runtime charts.
source_lifecycle: Both repositories must have clean worktrees at each entry/exit. RTGS HEAD stays equal to the init-run lock. Both behavior-bearing byte envelopes (.py/.cu/.cpp/.h/.cuh plus build configuration) remain exact. Struct metadata-only task-review commits between phases are permitted with unchanged byte envelopes, and old/new clean commits are recorded in prospective phase2 provenance. Ready RTGS task/review/raw seal never change. Results and documentation are written only after execution guards complete.

preview_policy.scope: diagnostic only, separate fresh reporting process after matrix; no quality selection or timing inclusion

consultative_review.scope: code/protocol text only; no local image/mask/model or downstream outcomes
consultative_review.verdict: conditionally acceptable phase1 design; independent exact source-bound RTGS and Struct approvals remain required

phase2_protocol_design.resource_directions: Formal portable schema requires higher/lower; resource signs are descriptive only and never objective-selection evidence. Only heldout_foreground_psnr is primary.
phase2_protocol_design.portable_aa: native primary/aa frame00008 seed19001 field_sweep; all3Stage1 predictors tolerance0,foregroundPSNR0.05,alphaIoU0.01; containedextraAA retained in RTGS diagnostics
phase2_protocol_design.source_indices: pixels/masks/cameras bind JSON descriptor indexes of exact raw-sealed files with train/heldout roles; indexes do not assert JSON contains image bytes
phase2_protocol_design.post_phase1_choices: Only artifact hashes and clean source provenance may be resolved; no scientific choice or threshold may change after generated fields exist.
